thread:
maria: CI red on master — flaky failure in //runtime/serve:serve_retry_on_timeout_test in build 14829. Fails ~1/7 runs with `deadline exceeded`. Can someone kick off a rerun and/or bisect?

devon: On it. Linking logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/14829/serve_retry/logs . Looks like the failure happens in a ~200ms window; test uses `time.Sleep` in a few places, so could be timing-dependent.

ci-bot: CI: rerun queued for build 14829 (rerun-14829).

liam: If it's timing-sensitive, try `go test ./runtime/serve -run TestRequestRetry -count 50 -test.cpu=1 -test.timeout=60s` and `GOMAXPROCS=1` for more determinism. Also we should bisect commit range e2a4..b3f8 where batching/prefetch changes landed.

maria: I can run stress locally with `go test ./runtime/serve -run TestRequestRetry -count 50` — starting now.

devon: Also pls check for RNG usage in retry backoff; we added jitter in 2024-09 which might interact with fake clock.

nate: I kicked off a bisect: `scripts/ci/bisect-test --from e2a4 --to b3f8 --test //runtime/serve:serve_retry_on_timeout_test` — will post updates.

ci-bot: Bisect job 452 queued. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/bisect/452

maria: Local stress: 1/50 failed. Relevant snippet: ```FAIL: TestRequestRetry (0.12s)
--- FAIL: TestRequestRetry (0.12s)
    retry_test.go:48: expected 3 retries, got 2```

devon: That matches. Hypothesis: fake clock/timer scheduling race — timer reset vs cancellation. Could be a goroutine scheduling window.

liam: Adding a `time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)` in test may reduce flakes but is a bandaid. Prefer making test use a deterministic fake clock or injecting a controllable ticker.

maria: Short-term: mark test flaky in CI (`@flaky` metadata) while we bisect. Prefer bisect first to find root cause.

nate: Bisect started: preliminary bad commit candidate b0f7c9 — touched kv-prefetch timer logic. Assigning to @devon to investigate.

devon: I'll take it. Can we run bisect with higher sample count? Add `-test.count=200` to the bisect job for more confidence.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll update bisect args.

ci-bot: Bisect 452 update: 3/10 bad so far, continuing.

liam: FYI saw similar intermittent in `kv_prefetch_test` last week — might be same root.

devon: Looking at b0f7c9 diff now: changed prefetch timer reset to avoid duplicate wakeups. I can repro locally with `go test -run TestRequestRetry -count 200` and `GODEBUG=schedtrace=1000` to get more scheduling info.

maria: Proposed fixes: (1) make timer reset atomic (mutex) in runtime code, or (2) make the test tolerant by polling with eventual assert instead of tight sleep-based timing.

nate: I'll open a PR to annotate the test flaky + add a tracking issue linking to bisect job. PR will include reproducer steps and temporary flaky marker.

maria: Follow-ups: @devon investigate b0f7c9 (owner), @nate open flaky PR, @liam prototype deterministic test refactor. Re-evaluate after bisect finishes. Ping here with updates.

devon: On it — will post a small repro patch if I find the root cause.

maria: Thanks all :heart:
